## This document creates all figures shown in the paper

```{r}
# Load in libraries
require(pacman)
pacman::p_load(dplyr, ggplot2, patchwork, tidyverse, lubridate, viridis, wesanderson, patchwork)
```

## Figure 2

```{r}
# This figure shows the aggregated CRPS of all sites across all depths
scores_aggregated <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  mutate(model_id = as.factor(model_id)) |>
  group_by(model_id, horizon) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
            mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))
            #mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T, trim = 0.25))

levels(scores_aggregated$model_id) <- c("No DA", "In situ (all depths)", "In situ (RS frequency)", "In situ (surface)", "RS", "RS (in situ uncertainty)")
  
  
groups <- c("No DA", "In situ (all depths)", "In situ (surface)", "In situ (RS frequency)", "RS", "RS (in situ uncertainty)")

ggplot(data = scores_aggregated, 
       aes(x = horizon, y = median_crps, colour = model_id, linetype = model_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  #scale_colour_viridis_d(labels = c("No DA", "In situ (all depths)", "In situ (surface)", "In situ (RS frequency)", "RS", "RS (in situ uncertainty)")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "",
                        values = setNames(c("solid", "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "solid", "dashed"), groups))  +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", 
                     values = setNames(c("#440154FF", "#2A788EFF","#2A788EFF","#2A788EFF", "#7AD151FF","#7AD151FF"), groups)) +

  labs(y = 'Median CRPS (°C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() #+
  #theme(legend.position = 'bottom', legend.margin = margin(t = -10))

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure2.png'), width = 6, height = 3, units = 'in', dpi = 400)

```

## Figure 3

```{r}
# This figure shows the aggregated CRPS across depths for each of the 10 sites
scores_sites <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  #filter(model_id == c("analysis_run_no_da", "analysis_run_with_rs", "analysis_run_with_insitu")) |>
  #filter(site_id != "PRLA" & site_id != "PRPO") |>
  group_by(model_id, horizon, site_id) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
            mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))

sitenames <- as_labeller(c("BARC" = "Lake Barco",
               "bvre" = "Beaverdam Reservoir",
               "ccre" = "Carvins Cove Reservoir",
               "CRAM" = "Lake Crampton",
               "fcre" = "Falling Creek Reservoir",
               "LIRO" = "Little Rock Lake",
               "PRLA" = "Prairie Lake",
               "PRPO" = "Prairie Pothole",
               "SUGG" = "Lake Suggs",
               "sunp" = "Lake Sunapee"))

without_pr <- ggplot(data = scores_sites[scores_sites$site_id != "PRPO" & scores_sites$site_id != "PRLA",], 
       aes(x = horizon, y = median_crps, colour = model_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~site_id, nrow = 2, labeller = sitenames) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d()+#begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, 
                         #labels = c("No DA", "With in situ", "With RS")) +
  labs(y = 'Median CRPS (°C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', legend.margin = margin(t = -10),
        strip.text = element_text(size=8))
without_pr

with_pr <- ggplot(data = scores_sites[scores_sites$site_id == "PRPO" | scores_sites$site_id == "PRLA",], 
       aes(x = horizon, y = median_crps, colour = model_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~site_id, nrow = 2, labeller = sitenames) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d()+#begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, 
                         #labels = c("No DA", "With in situ", "With RS")) +
  labs(y = 'Median CRPS (°C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', legend.margin = margin(t = -10),
        strip.text = element_text(size=8))
with_pr

without_pr + with_pr + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(4,1), guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = 'right', strip.text = element_text(size = 6))
  #theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 6))


ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure3.png'), width = 8, height = 3, units = 'in', dpi = 400)

```

## Figure 4

```{r}
# This figure shows the remote sensing temperature estimates plotted against the in situ temperature estimates
folders <- list.files("/Users/mollystroud/Desktop/postdoc/flare-rs-thermal/targets", full.names = T)
library(stringr)
alldata <- data.frame()
for(folder in folders){
  name <- str_sub(folder, start = -4)
  insitu <- read_csv(paste0(folder, '/', name, '-targets-insitu.csv')) |>
    filter(!is.na(observation)) |>
    filter(as.Date(datetime) >= "2021-01-02") |>
    slice_min(depth, n = 1) |>
    rename(insitu = observation) 
  rs <- read_csv(paste0(folder, '/', name, '-targets-rs.csv'))
  data <- left_join(rs, insitu, by = c('datetime', 'site_id'))
  alldata <- rbind(data, alldata)
}
alldata <- na.omit(alldata) |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  mutate(sd_resid = sd(observation - insitu))

# Now, show the (RS estimates vs. in situ estimates) vs. the overall accuracy of each site
overall_accuracy <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  filter(model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs") |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
            mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))

results <- alldata |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(bias = median(observation - insitu, na.rm = T))

ggplot(results_all, aes(x = median_crps, y = abs(bias), color = site_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_smooth(se = F, method = 'lm', aes(group = 1), 
              color = 'gray50', linetype = 'dashed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous'),
                     labels = c("BARC" = "Lake Barco",
                                "bvre" = "Beaverdam Reservoir",
                                "ccre" = "Carvins Cove Reservoir",
                                "CRAM" = "Lake Crampton",
                                "fcre" = "Falling Creek Reservoir",
                                "LIRO" = "Little Rock Lake",
                                "PRLA" = "Prairie Lake",
                                "PRPO" = "Prairie Pothole",
                                "SUGG" = "Lake Suggs",
                                "sunp" = "Lake Sunapee")) +
  labs(x = "Median CRPS (°C)", y = "Remote sensing observation \n median absolute bias (°C)",
       color = "")

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure4.png'), width = 5, height = 3, units = 'in', dpi = 400)
```

## Figure 5

```{r}
# This figure shows the CRPS for each site at each depth for forecasts with RS data assimilation, as well as the difference in CRPS for each site between RS data assimilation and no data assimilation
scores_depth <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
    dplyr::collect() |>
    filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
    filter(variable == "temperature") |>
    filter(horizon == 1) |>
    group_by(model_id, horizon, site_id, depth) |>
    summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
              mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))
  
scores_depth <- scores_depth |>
  arrange(site_id, depth) |>
  na.omit()

rs_depth <- ggplot(scores_depth[scores_depth$model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs",], 
       aes(x = median_crps, y = depth, color = site_id, group = site_id)) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous')) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = c("reverse")) +
  labs(x = "Median CRPS (°C)", y = "Depth (m)", color = "")

#ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure4a.pdf'), width = 6, height = 5, units = 'in')
#ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure4a.png'), width = 5, height = 3, units = 'in', dpi = 400)


diff_df <- scores_depth |>
  group_by(horizon, depth, site_id) |>
  summarise(median_crps_diff = median_crps[model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs"] - median_crps[model_id == "analysis_run_no_da"],
            mean_crps_diff   = mean_crps[model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs"] - mean_crps[model_id == "analysis_run_no_da"],
            .groups = "drop")

diff_depth <- ggplot(diff_df, 
       aes(x = median_crps_diff, y = depth, color = site_id, group = site_id)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'darkgray') +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous')) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = c("reverse")) +
  labs(x = 'Difference in CRPS (with RS - no DA)', y = "Depth (m)", color = "")

rs_depth + diff_depth + plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")
ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure5.png'), width = 7, height = 5, units = 'in')

```

## Figure 6

```{r}
# This figure shows the CRPS of each site during each season, aggregated across depth
scores_seasonal <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  #filter((month(datetime) >= 5 ) & (month(datetime) <= 9)) |> # SUMMER
  #filter((month(datetime) >= 10 ) | (month(datetime) <= 4)) |> # WINTER
  mutate(month = month(datetime), 
         season = case_when(
           month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
           month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
           month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
           month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall")) |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  group_by(site_id, model_id, horizon, season) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T))

ggplot(data = scores_seasonal[scores_seasonal$model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs",], 
       aes(x = horizon, y = median_crps, color = site_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous')) +
  labs(y = 'CRPS (degree C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure6.png'), width = 6, height = 5, units = 'in')


delta_seasons <- scores_seasonal |>
  filter(model_id %in% c("analysis_run_no_da","analysis_run_with_rs")) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = c(site_id, horizon, season),    # the keys that define a unique case
    names_from = model_id,                      # create a column for each model_id
    values_from = median_crps,
    names_glue = "median_{model_id}"            # nice column names
  ) |> mutate(
  diff_median_crps = median_analysis_run_with_rs -
    median_analysis_run_no_da) |>
  select(site_id, horizon, season,
         median_analysis_run_no_da,
         median_analysis_run_with_rs,
         diff_median_crps)
delta_seasons$season <- factor(delta_seasons$season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))


# This figure shows the difference in CRPS between RS and no RS for each season
ggplot(data = delta_seasons, aes(x = horizon, y = diff_median_crps, color = site_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous')) +
  labs(y = 'Δ CRPS (RS - no DA) (°C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'gray40', linetype = 'dashed') +
  annotate('text', x = 10, y = 2.5, label = 'no DA performs better', color = 'gray40') +
  annotate('text', x = 10, y = -0.7, label = 'RS performs better', color = 'gray40')

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure6X.pdf'), width = 6, height = 5, units = 'in')




# Now, just for surface estimates
scores_seasonal_3m <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(!is.na(observation)) |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  filter(depth == min(depth, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(month = month(datetime), 
         season = case_when(
           month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
           month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
           month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
           month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall")) |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  group_by(site_id, model_id, horizon, season) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T))




delta_seasons_3m <- scores_seasonal_3m |>
  filter(model_id %in% c("analysis_run_no_da","analysis_run_with_rs")) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = c(site_id, horizon, season),    # the keys that define a unique case
    names_from = model_id,                      # create a column for each model_id
    values_from = median_crps,
    names_glue = "median_{model_id}"            # nice column names
  ) |> mutate(
    diff_median_crps = median_analysis_run_with_rs -
      median_analysis_run_no_da) |>
  select(site_id, horizon, season,
         median_analysis_run_no_da,
         median_analysis_run_with_rs,
         diff_median_crps)

ggplot(data = delta_seasons_3m, aes(x = horizon, y = diff_median_crps, color = site_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous')) +
  labs(y = 'Δ CRPS (RS - no DA) (°C)', x = 'Horizon (days ahead)', color = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'gray40', linetype = 'dashed') +
  annotate('text', x = 10, y = 2.5, label = 'no DA performs better', color = 'gray40') +
  annotate('text', x = 10, y = -0.7, label = 'RS performs better', color = 'gray40')

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure6Y.png'), width = 6, height = 5, units = 'in')
```

## Figure 7

```{r}
# This figure shows the reliability of RS forecasts aggregated across depths and at depths 3-m or shallower
reliability_scores <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  filter(!is.na(observation)) |>
      mutate(is_in = between(observation, quantile10, quantile90)) |> 
      group_by(horizon, is_in, model_id, site_id) |> 
      summarise(n = n()) |> 
      pivot_wider(names_from = is_in, names_prefix = 'within_', values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |> 
      mutate(perc = within_TRUE/(within_FALSE + within_TRUE)*100)

  
rs_reliability <- ggplot(reliability_scores[reliability_scores$model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs",], 
       aes(x=horizon, y=perc, colour = site_id)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 90, colour = 'darkgray', linetype = 'dashed') +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    labs(y = 'Percentage of observations within\n90% confidence intervals', 
         x ='Horizon (days)',
         color = "") +
    annotate('text', x = 10, y = 100, label = 'underconfident', 
             size = 5, hjust = 1, color = 'gray30') +
    annotate('text', x = 10, y = 40, label = 'overconfident',
             size = 5, hjust = 1, color = 'gray30') +
    theme_bw() +
    ylim(0, 100) +
  annotate('text', x = 14, y = 0, label = 'All depths', size = 5, hjust = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous'))
#ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure6a.png'), width = 6, height = 5, units = 'in')

reliability_scores_3m <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  filter(!is.na(observation)) |>
  filter(depth <= 3) |>
  mutate(is_in = between(observation, quantile10, quantile90)) |> 
  group_by(horizon, is_in, model_id, site_id) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = is_in, names_prefix = 'within_', values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(perc = within_TRUE/(within_FALSE + within_TRUE)*100)
  
rs_reliability_3m <- ggplot(reliability_scores_3m[reliability_scores_3m$model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs",], 
       aes(x=horizon, y=perc, colour = site_id)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 90, colour = 'darkgray', linetype = 'dashed') +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    labs(y = 'Percentage of observations within\n90% confidence intervals', 
         x='Horizon (days)',
         color = "") +
    annotate('text', x = 10, y = 100, label = 'underconfident', 
             size = 5, hjust = 1, color = 'gray30') +
    annotate('text', x = 10, y = 40, label = 'overconfident',
             size = 5, hjust = 1, color = 'gray30') +
    annotate('text', x = 14, y = 0, label = '3-m and shallower', size = 5, hjust = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous'))

rs_reliability + rs_reliability_3m + plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure7.png'), width = 7, height = 5, units = 'in')

```

## Figure 8

```{r}
# This figure shows the Spearman's correlation 
stats_orig <- read_csv("LakeStats.csv")

accuracy_1day <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon == 1) |>
  filter(model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs") |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(crps_1 = median(crps, na.rm = T))

accuracy_14day <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon == 14) |>
  filter(model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs") |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(crps_14 = median(crps, na.rm = T))

stats_spearman <- left_join(stats_orig, accuracy_1day, by = c("siteID" = "site_id"))
stats_spearman <- left_join(stats_spearman, accuracy_14day, by = c("siteID" = "site_id"))
stats_spearman$crps_14_degrad <- stats_spearman$crps_14 - stats_spearman$crps_1

stats_spearman_long <- stats_spearman |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(crps_1, crps_14, crps_14_degrad, lake_name, siteID, state, mixing_regime, catchment_cover, website),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  filter(siteID != "PRPO")


spearman_corr_1 <- stats_spearman_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(value, crps_1, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spearman_corr_14 <- stats_spearman_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(value, crps_14_degrad, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = spearman_corr_1, aes(x = r, y = variable, color = "1 day"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = spearman_corr_14, aes(x = r, y = variable, color = "14 days"), size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 'dashed') +
  labs(x = "Spearman's correlation coefficient", y = element_blank(), color = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1 day" = '#277da1', "14 days" = '#f94144'))

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'Figure8.png'), width = 8, height = 5, units = 'in')

```

```{r}
alldata <- na.omit(alldata) |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  mutate(sd_resid = sd(observation - insitu))

# Now, show the (RS estimates vs. in situ estimates) vs. the overall accuracy of each site
overall_accuracy <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  filter(model_id == "analysis_run_with_rs") |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
            mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))

results <- alldata |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarize(bias = median(observation - insitu, na.rm = T))

results_all <- left_join(results, overall_accuracy, by = c("site_id"))

ggplot(results_all, aes(x = median_crps, y = abs(bias), color = site_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_smooth(se = F, method = 'lm', aes(group = 1), 
              color = 'gray50', linetype = 'dashed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette(10, name = "Zissou1", type = 'continuous'),
                     labels = c("BARC" = "Lake Barco",
               "bvre" = "Beaverdam Reservoir",
               "ccre" = "Carvins Cove Reservoir",
               "CRAM" = "Lake Crampton",
               "fcre" = "Falling Creek Reservoir",
               "LIRO" = "Little Rock Lake",
               "PRLA" = "Prairie Lake",
               "PRPO" = "Prairie Pothole",
               "SUGG" = "Lake Suggs",
               "sunp" = "Lake Sunapee")) +
  labs(x = "Median CRPS (°C)", y = "Remote sensing observation \n median absolute bias (°C)",
       color = "")

ggsave(paste0('paper_figs/', 'FigureS2.png'), width = 5, height = 3, units = 'in', dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
# OPEN DATA OF MEAN/OBSERVATION
scores <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(site_id == "LIRO") |>
  filter(model_id != "analysis_run_with_rs_05_obssd") |>
  filter(model_id != "analysis_run_no_da") |>
  group_by(datetime, site_id, model_id, depth) |>
  summarise_at(vars(median, observation, quantile97.5, quantile02.5), median, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  filter(depth == 0)
# PLOT
ggplot(data = scores, 
       aes(x = datetime, y = median, color = model_id)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymax= quantile97.5,
                  ymin = quantile02.5,
                  fill = model_id), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, 
                         labels = c("No DA", "With in situ", "With RS")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, 
                         labels = c("No DA", "With in situ", "With RS")) +
  geom_point(data = scores, aes(x = datetime, y = observation, 
                                color = 'In Situ'), 
             alpha = 0.5, size = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = rs, aes(x = datetime, y = observation, 
                            color = 'RS')) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("In Situ" = 'black', 'RS' = 'maroon')) +
  #facet_wrap(~depth) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Temp", x = "", color = "", fill = "")
```

```{r}
scores_sites <- arrow::open_dataset("scores/parquet/") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  filter(datetime > "2021-01-01") |>
  filter(variable == "temperature") |>
  filter(horizon > 0) |>
  filter(model_id == (c("analysis_run_with_rs", "analysis_run_with_rs_05_obssd"))) |>
  group_by(model_id, horizon, site_id) |>
  summarize(median_crps = median(crps, na.rm = T),
            mean_crps = mean(crps, na.rm = T))

sitenames <- as_labeller(c("BARC" = "Lake Barco",
               "bvre" = "Beaverdam Reservoir",
               "ccre" = "Carvins Cove Reservoir",
               "CRAM" = "Lake Crampton",
               "fcre" = "Falling Creek Reservoir",
               "LIRO" = "Little Rock Reservoir",
               "PRLA" = "Prairie Lake",
               "PRPO" = "Prairie Pothole",
               "SUGG" = "Lake Suggs",
               "sunp" = "Lake Sunapee"))

ggplot(data = scores_sites, aes(x = horizon, y = median_crps, colour = model_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~site_id, nrow = 2, labeller = sitenames) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(begin = 0.2, end = 0.8) +
```
